rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one subjected to cutting
optative expressing the unrealized effect of cutting
compound indicating absorption or attainment of that state
compound indicating the mind directed toward that reality
particle introducing the manner or condition

items.question: Can physical cutting harm a person whose mind is fully absorbed in that reality?
premises: A person may be subjected to the physical act of being cut.
That person has gone to that state and has the mind fixed on it.
Absorption in that reality prevents the ordinary effect of physical injury.
items.inference: Therefore, one whose being and mind are absorbed in that reality is not truly harmed by cutting.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' (tad) depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Even while being cut, one who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not actually cut.
